statements.says: Every file of a repo's Steering lives under docs/agents/.
CLAUDE.md loads the rules with an @ import each, so they are in every session from the start.
The preflight checks that each rule's import is still there.
The files a tool or a design places stay where they are: CLAUDE.md and .claude/settings.json, the glossaries and the ADRs, and a linter's own config.
A team finds all of its Steering in one place.
The rules must be in every session from the start while the rest is read only when a skill needs it, and the imports keep that split while the folder is one.
Deleting one import line would otherwise turn a rule off without a word.
Keeping the rules in .claude/rules/ and listing every file in a map was rejected, because although no import could go missing, a team would still look in two places.

Putting all of it under .claude/ was rejected, because Claude Code treats a write there as a protected path that only bypass mode allows, while the loop's default stays acceptEdits and a ticket has to be able to write its Steering.
Putting all of it in .claude/rules/ was rejected, because every session and every loop step would carry the reviewers' baselines too, and the loop still could not write there.
